initial_prompt: Can you briefly explain what RNA is?

messages.content: Can you briefly explain what RNA is?

RNA (ribonucleic acid) is a molecule similar to DNA that serves several key roles in cells. While DNA stores genetic information, RNA typically acts as a messenger - copying sections of DNA and carrying those instructions to cellular machinery that builds proteins. Some RNAs also have structural or regulatory functions, helping control which genes get expressed and when.
